summary: Show pending OMP ask options, recommendations, previews and question tabs above the web composer with terminal fallback

replay.detail: Reads existing native timeline input only; no claim replay changes.

schema.detail: No database, public client schema or persisted answer format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Web answer transport remains explicitly unavailable pending the metadata-only harness.answer contract and separately admitted adapter. Other and notes stay terminal-only.

downtime.detail: No restart coordination or expected service interruption.

manual.detail: No flags or operator actions are required; answer native questions with Open terminal.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes. Rolling back restores the previous alert surface without migrating or replaying answers.
